== Summary ==
A group outside at the [[2009 World Championship]], October 2009, from Kevbozzz's (Kevin Shannon's) "Worlds 2009" album. Identified: [[Jerry Heine]], [[Thomas McGee]], [[Kevin Shannon]], [[Brian Fred]], [[Chris Schoenthal]] and [[Dan Kim]] (maroon T-shirt, arms crossed, centre front), named in the labelled copy, [[:File:2009 World Championship labeled group photo.jpg]].

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by Kevbozzz: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=483637#p483637 post 483637], "Pics [Worlds 09]" (topic 31192), 17 November 2009. Photobucket album Kevbozzz/Worlds 2009, image IMG_1811.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).
